Bug 1:
"Delete permanently" gets selected instead of "Delete" on the bottom.

Bug 2:
Pressing enter does not select "Delete permanently" but triggers the "Delete" button

### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

comments:
Well, this is the fastest you can get using the keyboard: "Space" toggles permanent delete while "Enter" confirms it ;)

But I agree keyboard focus should be on the Delete button.

> Well, this is the fastest you can get using the keyboard: "Space" toggles permanent delete while "Enter" confirms it ;)
> 
> But I guess it's true keyboard focus should be on the Delete button.

I agree that it is really fast :P but probably not what the general user expects and because deleting files is a sensitive functionality, having it unexpectedly delete a file instead of ticking a box might scare users

@yaichenbaum However it's easier for you guys to handle ^^

This issue here was also about not accidentally hitting "confirm delete" via enter while the checkbox is focused but depending on what you want to do it's definitely overlapping
I'm not sure what changed but hitting enter does not seem to confirm delete, so perhaps the relevant issue now is only #5584.

> I'm not sure what changed but hitting enter does not seem to confirm delete, so perhaps the relevant issue now is only #5584.

only in recyclebin
